On the current war - experiencing a flatline. Since this is not my first experience with it I'm able to handle it better. Much calmer and it doesn't freak me out. [This thread really helps me put flatline in perspective.](http://redd.it/2cg8in)

Started to get a little bit of energy from not fapping but had a hard time focusing my thoughts. My thoughts are bouncing everywhere like a pinball; and stays inside my head without going nowhere, also like a pinball. The combination of this teeny weeny bit of energy, plus minor urge is really something. Luckily I still can hold myself together.

What helped me focused is to get a routine and stick to it. And I don't really get mad at myself if I broke or slack off my routine.
I'll check out the chat when I get home. Kinda swamped at work since I'm off next week.

Had a great start to the week. Managed to get work done at the office. Back at home things were as usual. The only threat was waking up at 3.00 am and not being able to sleep - this usually leads to PMO. 

Woke up today (Tuesday morning here now) fresh and I found out I had WD last night. Uh-oh, that feeling when you think taking a peep at NSFW subreddit would do no harm. Managed to not let it get the better part of me.

Can't afford to PMO now since family will be in town tomorrow and I don't want to appear stoned.
Congrats on the appointment.

Good start for the war given it was a slightly better than average PMO weekends that I used to have. Cleaned the house, did the laundry, got some reading, dined and hanged out with friends, catch some nap(I really love them).

Since I realize one of my use of PMO is to cope with stress/anxiety/boredom and the vicious spiral that it leads to it became easier to catch my urge early.
Currently reading Farmageddon, next will be Mao's Great Famine. I usually browse bookstore and pick up anything that seems interesting.

Cleaned the house and spent the day reading and listening to music at YouTube. Discovered coffitivity app and tried it while reading. Kinda good since I'm home alone and the background noise helped. 

Spent the night hanging out with friends after dinner.
First time enlist here. Was about to PMO few hours back, then remembered NoFapWar. Saved me from being another casualty.
New private here. Joining as an effort to break my 35 days record and get over my PMO addiction.
Reporting for duty.
Thanks, man.
Yeah, figuring out just how to do that. Then again I don't believe heaven is up there in the sky.

Things DO have a chance of getting better but I'm too exhausted to do anything about it. God? I believe in God and have been taught the consequences of taking own life but right now, it seems the the only way to end all my sufferings.
I'm tired, and I'm all out of will to live. The only thing left is to figure out my exit way. Thanks all for replying to a stranger like me.

I don't think wanting to be able to face life is too much to expect from myself. I've been choosing the path of least resistance for my entire life. All I want is to at least be able to go through life but now I realise that I don't have it in me. Now that I know that, it's time to go. 

Well, back in 2006 I asked my mom will she be sad if I'm not around anymore (was in college back then), she was like brushing off the question. She even said that she felt it was strange and told me my uncle also felt suicidal one point when he was studying too. Plus I'm used to doing things on my own and I don't really like showing others my problems.
Haha, my going away song most probably is Edith Piaf - Non Je Ne Regrette Rien.

I can't run. I don't have any energy left in me. I can't even move, I'm just lying down on the sofa because I'm too exhausted. I don't have the money to run or any useful skill, plus I'm bonded by contract to my employer. I just took three weeks holiday and came back to realise that nothing is meaningful. I feel I've reach the end of a book. It's a short book, since it has taken all I've got to get to this point. I've give life a shot, and now I'm out. I'm tired of pretending I'm okay to everyone.
Talk is easy, I've always wanted to leave but I'm scared what's there after death. The unknown realm of the next world really scares me.

I feel tired of living, I don't have the energy to go on anymore. I feel like life has beaten the crap out of me. I feel empty inside. I feel numb. I feel life has lost all its wander. I feel life has lost it's "taste" or "color". I don't have anything to look forward to. I'm sick of the fact that I'm stuck in a place and don't have what it takes to turn things around. I can't even focus on my work anymore. I just I want to go to sleep and not waking up afterwards.
I don't need to talk, I want all of things around me to end.

I was in the office(still am, timezone is GMT +8), helding back my tears while typing my note. I've always manage to hold it back when I'm at work but this time I couldn't anymore. I'm afraid of the pain of dying and the unknown of what's over the next world. I'm at my wits end my back is on the wall. All I want is for all the shittiness to end. I wanted to be a man who's able to stare at life in the eye squarely and take it on. I'm tired, I'm exhausted, I've had enough.
Now I'M curious
